title: Grand Coulee Dam Complex
extract: Grand Coulee Dam Complex is a complex of operating hydroelectric power plants in United States. The complex consists of the following projects: Grand Coulee Left hydroelectric plant Grand Coulee Right hydroelectric plant John W Keys III hydroelectric plant Nathaniel Washington hydroelectric plant
